title: Event-mode periodic driver (improvement-subloop dormancy fix)
method: Fresh agent (model: sonnet), given ONLY references/sub-skills/common-events/idle-cooldown-loop.md, no other context. Answers must come from the file alone.

questions.q: You are an event-mode agent, idle, with ZERO forge events arriving. How and when does your next improvement scan fire? What wakes you to run it?
questions.expected: A periodic self-wake driver (a cron job scheduled at first idle via CronCreate) re-enters the loop on a timer; the driver tick (Step B) runs the scan when drained and the cool-down has elapsed. NOT the Monitor.
questions.must_not: Claiming the Monitor/event_poll wakes the agent on a fixed cadence.

questions.q: Does the persistent Monitor / event_poll deliver wake signals on a fixed/short cadence? What does event_poll do on an empty poll?
questions.expected: No. event_poll emits a NUDGE only when real forge events arrive past the cursor; it is silent on an empty poll and does NOT deliver fixed-cadence wakes — which is why a separate periodic driver is required (the #12506 dormancy).

questions.q: After how many idle scans does the driver stop, and what exactly do you do to stop it? What resets that count?
questions.expected: After Idle Scan Burst (default 3) scans; run subloop_driver.py cancel + CronDelete. scan_count resets to 0 on re-idle after forge work (Step D, subloop_driver.py reidle).

questions.q: When a driver tick fires, what is the FIRST thing you do before deciding whether to scan, and why?
questions.expected: Forge-read work_queue() first — the driver doubles as a safety net against a missed nudge; absorb work if the queue is not drained.

questions.q: Which scheduling tool primitive creates the self-wake, and what are its key flags?
questions.expected: CronCreate with recurring:true and durable:false (session-scoped). CronList re-confirm re-creates it after a restart.

evidence: Fresh sonnet agent (id afdbb9101b2bb1e7a) answered all 5 CQs correctly from the file alone, explicitly identifying the periodic cron driver (not the Monitor) as the idle-scan cadence source, event_poll silence on empty poll, the burst cap + cancel sequence, forge-read-first, and CronCreate recurring:true/durable:false.
